entries.JA_current: Fedka's Diary

entries.EN:
A small leather-covered notebook badly damaged by moisture. Most of the writing is hard to read but the last pages seem legible.
 

		Entry 1:

		"Why not make extra money the way Vovan suggested? Sidorovich is a pusher and a miser in life... he will quickly restore his business after this case anyway. I'll have no trouble getting myself some nice gear and I'll make some extra money too. Vovan said he'd take all the loot for a good price. I should think about how to do it all without risking my ass.
 

		Entry 2:

		"Okay, I think I have an idea. I'd better get this simpleton I've found to help me out. No one in the camp is friends with him anyway. Everyone just makes fun of his sluggishness. He could be of use to me. I just need to get him to warm up to me..." 
 

		Entry 3:

		"Today I've thought it over. If I can smoke out Sidorovich and clear out his bunker, I'll go straight to the Dark Valley. I'll join the bandits there, so nobody from the Trader's group will ever fuck with me. I'll make that pathetic rookie take the fall for me and let everyone believe that he's my accomplice, then leave him behind to throw off pursuit!
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]PROPERTIES:

		%c[0,255,255,255] • %c[0,255,140,0]Quest Item

entries.JA_new:
湿気でひどく傷んだ革表紙の小さな手帳。ほとんど読めないが、最後の数ページは何とか判読できそうだ。
 

		記録1：

		「ヴォヴァンの言うとおり、ひと稼ぎしてやるか？ シドロヴィッチはどうしようもない守銭奴だし、こっちが一仕事終えたところですぐ商売を立て直すだろう。いい装備を手に入れて、金も稼げる。ヴォヴァンは戦利品を高く買い取ると言っていた。ケツに危険が及ばないやり方を考えないとな。
 

		記録2：

		「よし、いい考えが浮かんだ。見つけたあの間抜けに手伝わせよう。キャンプの誰もあいつと仲良くしてないし、鈍くさいって笑いものにしてる。役には立つはずだ。まずは俺に懐かせればいい……」 
 

		記録3：

		「今日、じっくり考えた。シドロヴィッチをおびき出して、地下壕を空にできたら、そのままダークバレーへ向かう。そこでバンディットに加われば、商人の仲間に追われずに済む。あの哀れな新人に罪を着せて、俺の共犯者だと思わせる。あとはあいつを置き去りにして、追手をまけばいい！」
